notes: 0017: speeds up repeated monitoring scans with persistent file fingerprints and batched indexed upload-history checks. Unchanged known duplicates are skipped without reading media or flooding the activity UI. Oversized files are excluded before upload queues; Preflight can still report them and now runs in the background. Windows ChangeTime and file identity invalidate cached fingerprints after edits/replacement; files are revalidated around batch queries and at the skip boundary. Group/topic and recursive-flat deduplication policies, reservations and history clearing are preserved. Includes 22 regression tests; 2000 synthetic duplicate files checked with two database connections instead of 3999.
